features: Connectivity: Often supports Bluetooth 4.1 or newer for stable wireless streaming from smartphones and tablets.
Audio Formats: Many versions are designed for lossless decoding, supporting formats like MP3, WAV, APE, and FLAC.
Controls: On-board tactile buttons typically allow for volume adjustment (V+/V-), track switching (Prev/Next), and mode selection
Power: Usually powered by 5V DC via a barrel jack or micro-USB, and some models include integrated amplifiers to drive small speakers directly
description: It serves as the main controller for electronic projects requiring audio input and power. Key features include Bluetooth connectivity, voice recording/playback, and USB/SD card slots for media playback. The board is designed for 3.7V - 5V DC power input. It typically includes 13 distinct voice and siren modes for public speaking.
